summary: Global state setter (__stdcall, byte input a1). Captures a1 into result, and only when it differs from the current global byte_7CE254 writes the new value to byte_7CE254 and clears dword_7CE250 to 0. Always returns the requested state byte. Invoked by SessionScoringUpdate (0x004643C0), sub_4A0030 (0x004A0030), sub_4A00A0 (0x004A00A0), sub_4A0250 (0x004A0250) and SystemOSAPICall (0x004A03F0).

operations.description: Capture the input byte a1 into result so the return value reports the requested state even when the state is unchanged.
Guard on byte_7CE254 != a1; when the current global state already equals the requested byte, the update block is skipped.
Write a1 into byte_7CE254 to set the new global state value.
Reset dword_7CE250 to 0 whenever the state value changes.
State setter invoked by SessionScoringUpdate (0x004643C0), sub_4A0030 (0x004A0030), sub_4A00A0 (0x004A00A0), sub_4A0250 (0x004A0250) and SystemOSAPICall (0x004A03F0).
Return result, the requested state byte.

unresolved: The semantics of the byte_7CE254 state and the dword_7CE250 counter it resets are not documented in this function; callers suggest session/OSAPI context.
Whether the write of a1 to byte_7CE254 is a full byte store or a masked flag update is not decidable from this function alone.
